notes.title: Upcoming Demo Release Info v1.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36873345/182b4d5e9e6cfdee31f09bfd412f700090a7fb2d.jpg

We’re excited to announce a new update for our upcoming demo. 
During the development of the Purgatory Guardian, We decided to add 2 coop missions including the campaign level. 
With that decision, the customization of characters become a possibility with a few helmets and shoulders armors. 
Since it's very impotant for us to have the support of the community, we want to attribute the option for the armors (available only for the demo) to be kept in the player's inventory for the full release.
